Algérie Poste lance CCP Business Cashles: Algeria Post launches CCP Business Cashless to accelerate electronic payment for professionals
ALGER, 25/07/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algér: ALGIERS, 07/25/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algérie Poste is taking a new step in the digitalization of financial services with the launch of CCP Business Cashless, a platform designed for businesses, merchants and professionals who want to manage their payments differently, without using cash.
À travers ce dispositif, l’entreprise pu: Through this system, the public company intends to simplify transactions, strengthen the security of operations and offer a more fluid solution to economic players.
En appui à ce lancement, une vidéo expli: To support this launch, an explanatory video was posted online to guide users through the registration and account opening steps, as a visual user guide intended to make the service more accessible.
Ce nouveau service s’inscrit dans la con: This new service is a continuation of the efforts led by Algérie Poste to accelerate the adoption of electronic payment in Algeria. The idea is clear: to evolve uses, reduce dependence on cash and gradually install a culture of digital payment in the national economic fabric.
Avec CCP Business Cashless, Algérie Post: With CCP Business Cashless, Algérie Poste is banking on a more modern, more practical approach that is better adapted to the needs of economic operators.
